title: Stale cache served after config change
symptom: Clients see the old page for ten minutes after a config change was applied.
contributing_factors: Reload was skipped because the unit file hash did not change
root_cause: The deploy role infers 'changed' from the unit file alone, so a config-only change never triggers a reload.
preventive_control: The role now notifies reload on any template change, and a post-deploy probe fetches a canary path.
verification: Change a canary template value; the probe must return the new value within 30 seconds or the deploy fails.
